vulnerability_analysis: The DoctorShiba contract has an owner-only function transfernewun() that sets a newun address. When newun is set, any transfer to that address will fail unless the sender is the owner. This allows the owner to arbitrarily block any address from receiving tokens, which is a privilege abuse vulnerability.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner, call transfernewun() to block a target address, then verify the blocking works by attempting transfers from non-owner and owner.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call transfernewun() with the target address to block. 4. Verify newun is set to target address. 5. Attempt transfer from non-owner to blocked address (should fail). 6. Attempt transfer from owner to blocked address (should succeed).
